Q: Git Stash equivalent of --theirs A:

In addition to @r3mus-n0x answer, you should provide the index of stash you want to check out. Then the fatal error should not occur.

$> git stash list
   stash@{0}: WIP on xxx: 466a845fe Fix: Deleted unnecessary comments

$> git checkout stash@{0} --theirs .

Confirmed with git-version 2.28.0

However, in git versions 2.43 and beyond, this will not work. Instead, you can use:

git cherry-pick -n -m1 -Xtheirs stash

(Here, stash means stash@{0}. You can also use stash@{1} or whatever stash it is that you want to apply.)

Q: Cannot connect to MySQL with docker compose A:

This could be a race condition. I can reproduce connection errors when the client is attempting a connection before the mysql database is up. This is more likely to happen with a container volume instead of just

- ./mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql

You could try to add a healthcheck:

  db:
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping", "-h", "localhost", "-u", "biker", "-p${DB_PASSWORD}"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5

  client:
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
